Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially misidentified James Douglas, 3rd Earl of Angus’s father as George Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus instead of the correct William Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus. This misidentification directed the search toward the wrong individual and set the investigation on an incorrect path before later corrections, risking an incorrect birthplace determination.
